question: According to Section 2.4, which document does validation relate back to, and is validation limited to delivery of end products?

function.name: search
function.arguments: {"query":"Section 2.4 validation relate back to document relates back to and not limited to delivery of end products"}

function.name: submit_answer
function.arguments: {"status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"In Section 2.4, validation relates back to the Concept of Operations (ConOps) document.","citations":[{"source_id":"NASA-SE:p0021","locator":"Section 2.4, paragraph beginning \"Validation relates back\"","evidence":"\"Validation relates back to the ConOps document.\""}]},{"text":"No. Validation is not limited to delivery using end products; it \"can be performed in each development phase using phase products (e.g., models) and not only at delivery using end products.\"","citations":[{"source_id":"NASA-SE:p0021","locator":"Section 2.4, final sentence of validation discussion","evidence":"\"Validation can be performed in each development phase using phase products (e.g., models) and not only at delivery using end products.\""}]}]}

function.name: submit_answer
function.arguments: {"status":"answered","claims":[{"text":"Section 2.4 states that validation relates back to the Concept of Operations (ConOps) document.","citations":[{"source_id":"NASA-SE:p0021","locator":"Section 2.4, validation paragraph","evidence":"“Validation relates back to the ConOps document.”"}]},{"text":"No. Section 2.4 says validation is not limited to delivery using end products; it can be performed in each development phase using phase products (e.g., models).","citations":[{"source_id":"NASA-SE:p0021","locator":"Section 2.4, validation paragraph (last sentence)","evidence":"“Validation can be performed in each development phase using phase products (e.g., models) and not only at delivery using end products.”"}]}]}
